public_policy.primary_use: Prioritize confection products for wrapper-history storytelling and source review.
public_policy.ingredient_gate: No ingredient claim is promoted from wrapper-front lineage photos unless a readable label panel is captured and manually reviewed.
public_policy.publication_gate: External images are link-only unless rights are clear.

top_targets.ingredient_claim_rule: Do not treat wrapper-front lineage photos as ingredient proof unless a readable ingredient/nutrition panel is visible and manually reviewed.
top_targets.rights_rule: Link out and store attribution first; do not republish external wrapper images unless rights are clear.
top_targets.recommended_action: Open the Candy Wrapper Archive collection/page rows first; select item-level wrapper records by decade, then look for back/side-panel proof elsewhere.
